description:
Ukraine's register of persons who committed corruption or corruption-related
offences (НАЗК).

An entry records one offender, the offence, the article they were held liable
under, the sanction, and the court decision or disciplinary decree that imposed
it. Most entries are natural persons sanctioned by a court.

`sentence_number`, where present, is the decision's ЄДРСР id, so an entry can be
checked against the decisions register itself.

This source publishes no freshness of its own, so `as_of` is mirror sync date.

q.description: Free text over name, offence, article, court and case.
